verdict.rationale: mise tasks live in `mise.toml` or script files that teams commit to git. Any versioning, review and rollback of those automations therefore comes from the user's own source control, not from a mise feature. `mise bootstrap plan`/`--dry-run` preview machine-setup changes, and lockfiles pin tool versions, but these are adjacent controls; neither versions nor rolls back the automations themselves.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
